label: integer-10000
_comment: The recorded input trace of GC-023's 10,000-step integer fixture: the shape, the seed and the schedules the player probe and the EditMode suite both drive, plus the real-Unity-jobs shape. Nothing here is derived at load time; the generator turns it into the step script deterministically (IntegerFixtureGenerator.Generate) and the jobs shape is declared field by field. `observationDigest` was captured from a passing Linux IL2CPP -probeReplay run; tools/unity/run_replay_probe.sh rejects a changed value. It is EMPTY here on purpose: the observation table grew from 12 to 15 named observations (the real-Unity-jobs half), so the previous value in `supersededObservationDigest` no longer describes the table and must be re-recorded from the first passing run of the new table. Until then the harness prints the observed digest and continues, so an unrecorded digest can never pass as a recorded one. Re-record by copying the value the harness prints in its `-- replay digest <hex> is not recorded yet` note on the first run of the new table (the same value appears in that run's `replay-digest` step detail), then re-running the probe so the comparison is enforced. Note that artifacts/gc-023/toolchain/probe-replay.json from the round-1 build-host run still holds the superseded 12-observation digest and must not be copied.
_hashes: Canonical state, decision, provenance, event and chain hashes are deliberately NOT literals here. The acceptance criterion TEST-022 states is that replays of the same recorded input agree with each other across worker counts, shuffled producer orders and publish permutations; a remembered hash would only assert that the code did not change, which is a weaker claim and a worse one to maintain. The probe and the suites compare two runs of this record, and the runs' hashes are recorded in the probe artifact (artifacts/gc-023/toolchain/probe-replay.json) as the build host's measurement.
